newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks ease in slow trading in London.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks ease in slow trading in London.

text.p: Japanese stocks eased in slow trading in London, tracking losses in Tokyo overnight.
"There has been no volume. It was thin (in Tokyo) overnight and it's pretty featureless here today," said one dealer.
At 1347 GMT, GMT, the Nikkei 50 average was down 7.60 points in London to 1,431.03.
Auto shares, which rose on Friday, turned mixed as more released their results. Shares in Toyota were up 10.0 yen to 2870; shares in Honda Motor and shares in Nissan were down 38 yen to 770 yen.
In Tokyo, the Nikkei 225 fell 133.36 points to 20,796.37.
